title: PeerReviewAgents
description:
A multi-agent LLM peer-review framework that simulates a journal editorial board (eight specialist reviewers, an advocate/skeptic debate, an area-chair synthesis, an author rebuttal, and an editor-in-chief verdict) to produce an accept / minor / major / reject recommendation on a manuscript, with full reports at every stage.

Garrett, Navarro Garrido and Garcia-Carbonell contributed equally.
